blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Aldous Torculas saved San Beda from a late-game meltdown to squeak past Emilio Aguinaldo College, 85-83, in Game 1 of the NCAA Season 102 Final Four on Monday at Mall of Asia Arena. With the score tied at 83-all, the defending champions turned to their old reliable for the game-winner against the heavy Generals’ defense. Torculas walked down Jude Bagay and even with help from Wilmar Oftana, the dynamic forward still sank the go-ahead midrange fadeaway with 3.1 ticks to go.
